title: LLM-Advisor: An LLM Advisor for Cost-efficient Path Planning across Multiple Terrains
abstract: arXiv:2503.01236v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper addresses fixed-graph terrain-aware path refinement, in which a global planner is restricted to a predefined route space and may remain optimal within that space while missing lower-cost terrain corridors available in the native-resolution map. We propose LLM-Advisor, an external verification-guided multimodal refinement framework that uses semantic terrain context to propose route alternatives with lower cost than the baseline route. The framework combines a multimodal prompt, map-disjoint Reference Example Augmentation (REA), and deterministic validation with fallback: a proposed route is deployed only when it is feasible and strictly lower in cost than the baseline. To evaluate the method, we introduce MultiTerraPath, a controlled 2,000-map benchmark with Easy and Hard subsets for fixed-graph terrain-cost refinement, and further conduct a semantic-cost transfer evaluation on RUGD. translated_abstract: arXiv:2503.01236v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：本文针对固定图地形感知路径细化问题，在该问题中，全局规划器被限制在预定义的路由空间内，并可能在该空间内保持最优，但会遗漏原生分辨率地图中可用的低成本地形走廊。我们提出了LLM-Advisor，一种外部验证引导的多模态细化框架，利用语义地形上下文来提出比基线路线成本更低的路线替代方案。该框架结合了多模态提示、地图分离的参考示例增强（REA）以及确定性验证与回退机制：只有当提议路线可行且成本严格低于基线时才会部署。为了评估该方法，我们引入了MultiTerraPath，一个受控的2,000地图基准测试，包含Easy和Hard子集，用于固定图地形成本细化，并进一步在RUGD上进行了语义成本迁移评估。使用粗格A*进行条纹...
tldr: 本文提出LLM-Advisor框架，通过语义地形上下文和外部验证，在固定图路径规划中生成成本更低的替代路线，并引入MultiTerraPath基准测试验证其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLM-Advisor, a multimodal refinement framework that leverages semantic terrain context and external verification to generate lower-cost route alternatives in fixed-graph path planning, validated via the new MultiTerraPath benchmark.
